## v0.5.47: Clearer Settings and Optional Memory Controls / 更清晰的设置与可选记忆控制

- Consolidate settings and UI controls, improve narrow layouts, keyboard navigation and reduced motion, and reduce repeated frontend work (#645–#649, #652, #653).
- Fix exact Holographic archive evidence, Source locale fallback and Agent-specific memory-tool hints (#659–#661).
- Apply conservative capture guidance and support optional skill creation directories (#662, #663).
- Add optional deferred low-priority Runtime details and per-operation approval for model-facing memory writes. Both default to off (#664, #665).

- 整理设置与控件，改善窄屏布局、键盘操作和减少动效体验，降低前端重复工作（#645–#649、#652、#653）。
- 修复 Holographic 精确归档证据、Source 语言回退和 Agent 记忆工具提示（#659–#661）。
- 统一保守的自动捕获标准，支持可选技能创建目录（#662、#663）。
- 增加可选的低优先级 Runtime 详情延迟加载，以及模型记忆写入逐次确认；两项均默认关闭（#664、#665）。

Updates Starter **0.5.47** and 14 component packages. Four unchanged Providers retain their published versions. Storage formats and existing data remain compatible. / 更新主包 **0.5.47** 与 14 个组件；另四个 Provider 保持原版本，存储格式与已有数据兼容。

Update through **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then fully restart DSH. / 通过 **记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新** 升级后，完整重启 DSH。

Write confirmation covers model-facing Mnemon memory tools and pauses idle review when enabled; manual UI, CLI/RPC, Git, shell and independent Skills automation retain their own authorization. / 写入确认覆盖模型调用的 Mnemon 记忆工具，开启后暂停空闲整理；手动 UI、CLI/RPC、Git、Shell 和独立技能自动化保留各自的授权流程。
